I've saved the draft mail to Hollis. It hasn't been sent; someone still has to send it from the drafts.

- To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
- Subject: "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- Body: it gives the proposed 2027 rate of $2,101 per seat, as Marcus Lindqvist gave it, and says you approved sharing it with Hollis.

I didn't need any further approval. Your message counts as the finance approval, and since Hollis has a pemberline.com address, Ruth doesn't need to approve it. I also confirmed all this to you in our direct message.

One thing to know: I couldn't find any Thornbury Cloth Co. files in the share I can see. So the $2,101 figure in the mail comes from your message, not from a document I checked.
